source.extractionTool: Embedded OCR text layer of the scanned PDF (Adobe Scan for Android), read with pdftotext (poppler) -enc UTF-8 raw and -layout; pdfplumber to inspect the layer; every question checked and corrected against pypdfium2 page renders
source.notes: No official marking scheme is published with this paper; questions carry no official answer. From the CISCE Archive Library ISC 2025 question-paper bundle. The PDF is a phone scan (Adobe Scan) of the printed paper; its text layer is Adobe's OCR, which has many recognition errors (e.g. 'rcading', 'matr1x', '15 kg' for '1·5 kg') and loses nearly all mathematical notation (integrals, limits, matrices, determinants, fractions, powers, vector arrows). Every question was therefore transcribed against a render of the page image: OCR errors in words were corrected to what is printed and all maths was rebuilt inline (fractions as a/b, powers as Unicode superscripts, matrices/determinants as [row; row] / |row; row|, definite integrals as ∫_{lower}^{upper} or ∫₀¹); such items are flagged MEDIUM. Paper code '1225-860' is printed in the footer of every page; the number 'T5017028' printed at the top of the cover page appears to be a copy serial and is not used. Cover: 'Maximum Marks: 80', 'Time Allotted: Three Hours', 'Reading Time: Additional Fifteen minutes', 22 questions in three sections. Section A (65 marks) is compulsory; candidates attempt ALL questions of EITHER Section B (vectors, 3-D geometry, application of integrals; 15 marks) OR Section C (applications of calculus in commerce/economics, regression, linear programming; 15 marks). Both Sections B and C are included here, so the pack's marks total (95 counting one alternative per OR pair) exceeds maxMarks (80) by design. Internal OR choices (Q4, 6, 8, 9, 11, 12, 16, 18, 20, 21) share a choiceGroup equal to the question number; alternatives are labelled (i)/(ii) as printed. Question 1's 15 sub-parts and Question 13's four sub-parts are separate entries with their printed marks; Q15 and Q19 sub-parts are split likewise. Sub-parts sharing one context (Q5, Q9(ii), Q10, Q15(iv), Q17, Q18(i), Q19(iii), Q21) are kept together with per-part marks in the text. Tables are reproduced as text rows. Regression items in Section C (Q19(ii), Q19(iii), Q20) have no matching chapter slug and are left with chapter null. No cognitive-level tags are printed on this paper.
